title: Culling Optimization Using Meshlets
subtitle: Capstone Project
overview: High-performance GPU culling using mesh shaders and meshlets in Unity + DirectX12.
description:
• Engineered a cutting-edge culling optimization system utilizing meshlet technology to enhance rendering performance in 3D environments.
  • Developed a custom DirectX 12-based renderer with HLSL shaders, achieving significant frame rate improvements in complex scenes.
  • Demonstrated proficiency in advanced graphics programming, real-time rendering techniques, and performance optimization strategies.

title: Changeling
subtitle: 3D VR Mystery Game
overview: A narrative-driven VR game built in Unreal Engine 4 with immersive interactions and puzzles.
description:
• Developed a fully functional prototype for a major level in a 3D VR mystery game, collaborating with a cross-disciplinary team of over 20 designers, artists, and audio engineers.
  • Leveraged Unreal Engine 4 to craft immersive gameplay experiences while ensuring seamless UI/UX design and detailed project documentation.

title: Data Analysis on Income Inequality
subtitle: Unity Application
overview: Interactive data visualization tool exploring global income inequality using Unity and Python.
description:
• Built an interactive Unity-based application to visualize the impact of income inequality over time using Python and GeoJSON data.
  • Combined advanced data analysis techniques with Unity tools to present chronological trends, showcasing technical expertise in programming, data parsing, and spatial visualization tools like Mapbox.

title: Greg, Son of Greg
subtitle: Roguelike Dungeon-Crawler Game
overview: A roguelike dungeon crawler featuring procedural levels, combat, and RPG progression.
description:
• Designed and developed a rogue-like dungeon crawler with procedurally generated levels, where players inherit skills through successive generations.
  • Delivered an engaging gameplay experience by implementing procedural generation algorithms, dynamic UI/UX elements, and detailed project documentation using Unity and C#.

title: Terrain Generation with Delaunay Triangulation
subtitle: Pedagogical Aid
overview: Educational tool that visualizes terrain generation using Delauney triangulation and adjustable parameters.
description:
• Developed an interactive web-based tool to demonstrate the Delaunay triangulation algorithm, showcasing expertise in computational geometry and real-time 3D rendering.
  • Implemented a user-friendly interface and utilized Three.js to create dynamic, visually engaging terrain visualizations.
  • Highlights ability to combine algorithm design with interactive web development.

title: Sentiment Analysis
subtitle: Research Project
overview: Sentiment analysis study comparing ensemble and attention-based neural networks across multiple text domains.
description:
• Implemented and evaluated an attention-based LSTM model for binary sentiment classification, comparing its performance against a hybrid BiLSTM-ANN ensemble model.
  • Developed NLP preprocessing and feature engineering pipelines using NLTK, WordNet hypernyms, tokenization, POS tagging, stopword removal, and pretrained GloVe word embeddings.
  • Evaluated model generalization across movie reviews, Twitter posts, and financial news, with the AT-LSTM achieving 84.41% validation accuracy and outperforming the ensemble model across all three datasets.

title: Graph-Based Information Retrieval Analysis
subtitle: Research Project
overview: Sensitivity analysis of evaluation coefficients used to rank graph-based information retrieval models.
description:
• Performed a secondary analysis of existing Pruned and Conceptualized Graphical Set-Based information retrieval models evaluated on the Cystic Fibrosis Collection.
  • Designed and executed systematic parameter sweeps over fusion coefficients representing relative performance, mean average precision, and graph-pruning efficiency to measure their effect on model rankings.
  • Developed Python scripts and Matplotlib visualizations to compare ranking behavior across coefficient combinations, identifying strong overall preference for conceptualized graph models and sensitivity to pruning and precision weights.
